messages:
Ava: Quick thought 1 1 can we show an inline runtime hint in saved queries list so engineers know which route/model and rough token cost before clicking?
Ravi: Support and AE teams keep asking for that. Do we have reliable signal?
Lina: We have per-route p90 length + model unit cost table. Good enough for a ballpark.
Ethan: Dev note: prefer computed blobs stored with saved_query metadata rather than compute at render time. Avoids N+1.
Ava: UX: small pill for model, cost bucket (low/med/high), and a routing tag. Tooltip "estimate" and a link to "how we calculate".
Ravi: Agree. Add an estimated_confidence field (low/med/high) so UI can hide low-confidence estimates.
Lina: Suggest pipeline: nightly job merges route histograms + model-costs -> hint doc with schema v1.
Ethan: API should add `runtime_hint` optional object and `hint_schema_version`. Backward compatible.
Ava: Can we also include `percentile_used` (e.g., p90) so users can see the conservatism?
Lina: Yes. We'll record percentile and sampling window (last_30d).
OpsBot: deploy: saved-query-hints-worker:v1 scheduled at 2024-11-14T03:00:00Z.
Ethan: Performance: keep hint <= 800 bytes, provide bulk hints endpoint to fetch many at once.
Ravi: Rollout: feature flag + 5% canary and micro-survey. If low confidence hide cost badge.
Ava: I'll mock screens and bounce copy for hover. Thanks all. :sparkles:
